summary: One integration registry declares InfraNodus, Hugging Face and Modal; each states the env-var NAMES it needs, computes 'configured' from their presence, and reaches nothing when unconfigured.

notVerified: the upstream tool inventory — the server was never dialed, so no tool names are hardcoded

publishedFor: row 6 — Modal preset selects a Hugging Face model

routeRegistration.registeredFrom: server/src/api/mcp.ts registerMcpRoutes(), already called at server/src/index.ts:262

findings.summary: Hugging Face is not greenfield: the vendored engine already pins HF_TOKEN and has a regression test against the HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY spelling.

docs/inventory/ownership.json:452 grants lane F11 server/seed/skills/infranodus-ontology-creator/**, a path that does not exist. F11's InfraNodus skill must call mcp__infranodus__<tool> rather than open a second InfraNodus client.
The Modal not-configured message was duplicated verbatim at manager.ts:259 and adapter.ts:89. Both now import one shared constant.

Round 2, from adversarial review: GET /integrations spawned `modal --version` synchronously on every call (~0.7s of blocked event loop). The listing now resolves PATH only; the version and the workspace are read asynchronously and memoised on GET /integrations/modal/cli.

Round 2, from adversarial review: POST /integrations/:id/register wrote into mcp.json without consulting mcp-disabled.json, so registering an already-disabled connector put the same name in both stores and wedged the toggle in both directions. It now answers 409 ALREADY_DISABLED, and the wire carries mcp.disabled so the panel can say so.

Round 2: the round-1 Gate D focus-ring numbers (2.58 light / 4.18 dark) were the FULL-OPACITY --ring token, not the rendered 50%-alpha ring. Remeasured from rendered pixels; see wave-f/reports/F12-evidence.md.
